title: 第1214章 草原修士第1213章 三阶妖族
content_zh:
有些生活在偏远区域的妖族部落会与人族修士进行有限的贸易和交涉，有些被收服的妖兽也会成为人族修士的战宠和灵兽。
甚至有些化形妖族会在人族坊市中混迹，以伪装的身份从事各种活动。
但无论如何，妖族修士出现在人族坊市中本身就是一件极为敏.感的事情。
尤其是在长原城这种人族联盟的军事重镇周边，一旦被发现妖族潜伏，很可能会引发大规模的搜捕和清剿。
能在这里潜伏下来的，要么是伪装成人类修士模样的化形妖族，要么就是被人以某种手段收服或豢养的战宠类妖兽。
他观察了片刻后，确认这三只三阶妖族的动作完全静止，它们蜷缩在那片阴影中一动不动，甚至没有转头的动作，灵力波动被压制到了极低的水平，完全是一种蛰伏休眠的状态。
如果不是虚维之眼的全知视角能够穿透它们的伪装遮蔽，仅凭普通的神识扫描根本不可能发现它们的存在。
看起来它们也是不想引人注意的，它们藏身在此处的时间应该已经相当长了，以至于周围的灰尘和蛛网都覆盖在了它们所在的废料堆表面，说明它们完全不想暴露。
三阶妖族，相当于人类修士的金丹期的实力，对他目前的梦身来说构不成实质性的威胁。
他并不担心与它们正面遭遇，但这件事让他对金竹坊“人员混杂”的特点有了更加直观和深刻的认识。
他收回了虚维之眼，将注意力重新聚焦在自己身上。
确认了金竹坊的情况确实与他打听到的信息一致，他在心中做出了决定，就在这里落脚。
不过，在真正进入坊市之前，他还要做最后一步准备工作。
易长生现在的形象是还是在归元洞天的样貌，虽然在归元洞天时，并没有人见过他，但他觉得还是要伪装一番为好。
如果就这么直接走进金竹坊，虽然未必会有人盘问，但在一座散修聚集的坊市中，一个完全没有来路背景的生面孔依然可能会引起某些好事者的注意。
尤其在金竹坊这种人员混杂的地盘上，散修之间彼此打探来路、评估威胁是再常见不过的事情。
他需要一个能够融入环境、看起来像是这片区域的散修的形象。
易长生从矮丘背面站起身来，环顾了一圈周围的环境。
此处距离金竹坊约三百里，是一片长满了低矮灌木和野草的荒坡，视野开阔，方圆数里之内没有任何人烟和建筑，正是实施伪装的好地方。
他找了一处相对平坦的岩石坐下来，将后背靠在一块突出的岩壁上，然后开始催动虚空造形术。

他在脑海中勾勒出了自己想要变化的形象。
心幻平原上的散修，那是一个他见过样本最多、最熟悉也最不容易引起怀疑的形象。
心幻平原横跨数百万里，其中散布着无数中小城池和村落，聚居着大量祖祖辈辈生长在那里的修士，他们的长相因长期生活在那片特定环境中而有着某些共同的特征。
content_en:
Some demon tribes living in remote areas will conduct limited trade and negotiations with human monks, and some subdued demon beasts will also become war pets and spiritual beasts of human monks.
There are even some transformed monsters who hang out in the human race market and engage in various activities in disguised identities.
But in any case, the appearance of demon monks in the human race city is an extremely sensitive matter.
Especially around Changyuan City, a military center of the Human Alliance, once the demon clan is discovered to be lurking, it is likely to trigger a large-scale manhunt and suppression.
Those who can lurk here are either transformed monsters disguised as human monks, or war pet monsters that have been tamed or raised by people in some way.
After observing for a moment, he confirmed that the movements of the three third-level monsters were completely still. They huddled in the shadow and remained motionless, without even turning their heads. The fluctuations in their spiritual power were suppressed to an extremely low level, and they were completely dormant.
If it weren't for the omniscient perspective of the Eye of Virtual Dimension that could penetrate their camouflage, it would have been impossible to discover their existence with ordinary divine scanning alone.
It seems that they don't want to attract attention. They must have been hiding here for a long time, so that the surrounding dust and cobwebs are covering the surface of the waste pile where they are, indicating that they do not want to be exposed at all.
The strength of the third-level demon clan, which is equivalent to the golden elixir stage of human monks, does not pose a substantial threat to his current dream body.
He was not worried about encountering them head-on, but this incident gave him a more intuitive and profound understanding of the "mixed people" characteristics of Jinzhufang.
He withdrew the Eye of Virtual Reality and focused his attention on himself again.
After confirming that the situation in Jinzhufang was indeed consistent with the information he had learned, he made a decision in his heart and settled here.
However, before actually entering the market, he still had to make one last step of preparation.
Yi Changsheng's current image is still the same as he was in Guiyuan Cave Heaven. Although no one has seen him in Guiyuan Cave Heaven, he feels that it is better to disguise himself.
If you just walk into Jinzhufang directly, although no one may question you, in a market where casual cultivators gather, a stranger with no background may still attract the attention of some busybodies.
Especially in a place like Jinzhufang where people are mixed, it is common for casual cultivators to inquire about each other's origins and assess threats.
He needed an image that could blend into the environment and look like a casual cultivator in the area.
Yi Changsheng stood up from the back of the short hill and looked around the surrounding environment.
This place is about three hundred miles away from Jinzhufang. It is a barren slope covered with low shrubs and weeds. It has a wide view and there are no people or buildings within a few miles. It is a good place for camouflage.
He found a relatively flat rock to sit down, leaned his back against a protruding rock wall, and then began to activate the Void Shaping Technique.
He created a mental image of what he wanted to change.
The casual cultivator on the Plain of Mental Illusion was the image he had seen the most, the most familiar, and the least likely to arouse suspicion.
The Fantasy Plain spans millions of miles, and is dotted with countless small and medium-sized cities and villages. It is home to a large number of monks who have grown up there for generations. Their appearance has certain common characteristics because they have lived in that specific environment for a long time.
